subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4) i.e. 'after'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **'sought after'** is commonly used to describe something that is greatly desired or in high demand.
 
• Using 'after' in this context indicates that the art of Bonsai became highly popular and widely pursued in China.
 
• The word 'after' finalizes the statement in a way that clearly communicates the desirability of the Bonsai art in China.<
